//: The project adapter. Copy to g9.project.json in the repo of the app under test —
NOT into this tool. Everything the tool knows about your product lives here, as data,
so the extension itself stays usable on any site without being untangled from one.
//urlNormalizers: Collapse routes only your app knows are the same operation. Applied to the path before comparison, so /tasks/<guid> and /tasks/<other-guid> stop looking like two different requests.
//secretRefs: NAMES only. A value here would be a credential in a file that gets committed.
//volatile: A last-resort manual mask. Prefer `g9 calibrate`, which finds these by running the flow twice and needs nobody to guess.
//operationAliases: Friendlier names in reports and Jira summaries.
//destructiveActions: Accessible names an exploratory run must never click. Advisory today; the state-graph explorer will enforce it.
//reportSink: Where a scheduled run posts its artefacts. The runner writes files regardless.
